authorization: User requested parallel specialists; persisted production contract authorizes bounded specialist work.

fixed_contract.format: Original HTML manuscript fragments; standard-library Python; offline operation.
fixed_contract.minimum: 2 fully worked examples and 8 original exercises with complete solutions; assumptions, units, limitations, teach-back and delayed check.
fixed_contract.review: Each specialist reviews its manuscript and supplies a executable numerical/behavior checker; root independently audits and alone accepts, builds and publishes. Drafting may overlap prerequisite work; acceptance may not.
fixed_contract.sources: Primary sources inspected; exact URLs and inspection scope recorded. Source suggestions are separate files until integration.
prohibitions: No editing another assignment or central curriculum/source/checkpoint/build/verify/hosting files
No commits, pushes, deployment or further agents
No framework, new installation, paid services, or claims of error-free/world-best authorship

assignments.outcome: Choose and interpret figures that expose rather than conceal evidence.
Estimate quantities by simulation and assess Monte Carlo error.
Derive ordinary least squares and interpret fitted values and residuals.
Distinguish descriptive associations from identified causal effects.

peer_reviews.scope: Read-only independent manuscript/math/exercise/laboratory review; root resolves findings.
peer_reviews.root_disposition: All suggestions resolved; no open material finding.
